title: Gold-set label record (v1 BDC cohort)
description: One JSON object per line in data/gold/labels/*.jsonl and data/gold/candidates/*.jsonl. Append-only. A label is asserted from the cached source filing, never from pipeline output.

provenance.description: Shared provenance fields on every record.

accession.description: Accession of the cached filing the label was read from.

source_ref.description: Exact pointer into the source so the label is auditable.

doc.description: Relative path of the cached source doc, e.g. data/raw/filings/bdc_html/1287750/0001287750-25-000012.html

context_id.description: iXBRL contextRef anchoring the position/fact (per-position records).

note.description: Free-text adjudication note: which table/row, what made it ambiguous, etc.

adjudicator.description: human:<name> for confirmed labels; agent:<labeler-id> for candidates.

pipeline_version.description: git SHA of the pipeline the label was judged against.

stratum.description: Which sample stratum this unit was drawn from (carried from the sample frame).

supersedes.description: label_id of a prior record this one corrects, if any.

label_id.description: Stable id for this record (hash of cik+report_date+key+labeled_date).

source_identifier.description: Raw position identifier exactly as it appears in the filing (issuer + tranche).

unit_uid.description: Link back to the pipeline row (position_id / position_key). For the fixer side and join only; NOT read by the labeler.

true_classification.description: Index classification as read from source (e.g. DIRECT_LENDING, DIRECT_EQUITY).

true_lien.description: Lien tier as read from source / filer subtotal (FIRST_LIEN, SECOND_LIEN, SUBORDINATED, UNSECURED, or null when the filer gives no lien evidence).

true_rate.description: All-in/contractual rate, percent scale. Deferred in batch 1.

true_maturity.description: Maturity date YYYY-MM-DD. Deferred in batch 1.

ambiguous_fields.description: Fields that are genuinely indeterminate from source; left null and recorded here rather than forced.

disposition.description: Scope verdict for the ROW (distinct from field values). 'valid' = a real holding. Anything else = a confirmed over-inclusion that must NOT be an index constituent: aggregate_subtotal (a category total / sum of other rows, e.g. a 'Co-investment' line), look_through (a JV/co-invest vehicle's underlying that double-counts the interface line), comparative (a prior-period row), non_position (other). For non-valid dispositions the true_* values may be recorded for reference but the row is flagged for exclusion, and the note should state the evidence.

true_total_investments_fv.description: Total investments at fair value for the fund-quarter, read from the financial statements / companyfacts InvestmentOwnedAtFairValue no-dimension total. Independent of the position-level pipeline.

true_position_count.description: Count of genuine position rows in the schedule (excluding subtotal/category and comparative-period rows).

subtotal_rows.description: Identifiers/context_ids of subtotal or category-header rows that must NOT enter position-level holdings.

comparative_rows.description: Identifiers/context_ids of prior-period (comparative) rows present in the doc.
